tasks.title: Promote staged migrations to the live tree and disable synchronize
tasks.dod: the promoted TypeORM migrations apply cleanly against an empty database and revert cleanly, and synchronize is off

tasks.title: Add pet DTOs, public types, and mappers
tasks.dod: CreatePetDto/UpdatePetDto reject an empty/too-long name and a future date of birth via class-validator, and toPublicPet/toPublicCoOwner unit tests confirm no credential field is ever present

tasks.title: Wire PetModule and register it in AppModule
tasks.dod: the app boots with PetModule registered (TypeOrmModule.forFeature([Pet]) + ListFilterModule + PetTypeModule + UserModule imported) and Nest's module graph resolves with no circular-dependency error

tasks.title: Add the assertCoOwner authorization helper
tasks.dod: unit tests for assertCoOwner(petId, callerId) pass for all three branches — pet missing (NotFoundException), pet exists but caller absent from membership (ForbiddenException), caller is a member (returns the loaded pet)

tasks.title: Implement create pet (POST /api/pets)
tasks.dod: integration test: valid input persists the pet, adds the creator as first Co-owner, and returns the pet without a co-owner list (AC-01); invalid name/date is rejected with no row written (AC-02); an unknown typeId is rejected (AC-03)

tasks.title: Implement view pet and browse pets (GET /api/pets/:id, GET /api/pets/list)
tasks.dod: integration test: GET /:id returns name/dateOfBirth/type without a co-owner list (AC-04) and 404s on a missing pet (AC-12); GET /list returns a bounded, stably-ordered page via ListFilterService (AC-05)

tasks.title: Implement update pet — full replace (PUT /api/pets/:id)
tasks.dod: integration test: a non-Co-owner is denied and the pet is unchanged (AC-06); a Co-owner's valid full replacement persists and is returned without a co-owner list (AC-06b); an unknown typeId is rejected (AC-03); a missing pet 404s before the authz check runs (AC-12)

tasks.title: Implement delete pet (DELETE /api/pets/:id)
tasks.dod: integration test: a non-Co-owner is denied and the pet remains (AC-07); a Co-owner's delete removes the pet and clears its membership links via ON DELETE CASCADE (AC-07b); a missing pet 404s before the authz check runs (AC-12)

tasks.title: Implement view co-owners and add co-owner (GET/POST /api/pets/:id/co-owners)
tasks.dod: integration test: co-owner list never includes a password/credential field (AC-08); a non-Co-owner is denied and membership is unchanged (AC-09); a Co-owner adding a new user extends membership (AC-09b); adding an existing Co-owner again is a no-op success (AC-09c); a missing pet 404s before the authz check runs (AC-12)

tasks.title: Implement remove co-owner under the no-orphan invariant (DELETE /api/pets/:id/co-owners/:userId)
tasks.dod: integration test: a pessimistic-lock transaction (ADR-0002) rejects removing the last Co-owner (AC-10); removing another Co-owner or self-removal leaves ≥1 owner and updates membership (AC-11, AC-11c); removing a non-member target is blocked with membership unchanged (AC-11b); a missing pet 404s before the authz check runs (AC-12)

tasks.title: Add the concurrent no-orphan invariant test (QG-2)
tasks.dod: an integration test fires two simultaneous remove-co-owner requests on a two-Co-owner pet and asserts the pet always ends with ≥1 Co-owner, no orphan possible

tasks.title: Add authorization and not-found negative tests across every write path (QG-1)
tasks.dod: a negative-path integration test suite covers update/delete/add-co-owner/remove-co-owner for both a non-Co-owner caller (denied, state unchanged) and a non-existent pet (not-found, not disguised as a 403), asserting the AC-12 not-found-before-authorization ordering

tasks.title: Add response-shape privacy tests (QG-3)
tasks.dod: response-shape assertions on create/view/list/co-owners routes confirm no password or credential field is ever present in the JSON body
